analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 214,500) vs SMA5 (KRW 229,300)/SMA20 (KRW 264,100)/SMA50 (KRW 299,920) — below, indicating weak short- to mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 256,993)/SMA200 (KRW 192,015) — maintaining weak long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (47.9%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.4 → 35.7) — entering oversold, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -3197.6937 → -5440.5720) — worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 207,574) — approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 167,300) — based on Pivot S1 (KRW 160,800) and 52-week low (KRW 67,500).
· Swing resistance (KRW 223,000) — based on Pivot PP (KRW 242,900) and SMA5 (KRW 229,300).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not met, Lower High not met) — indicating a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.79x) — subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — buy entry conditions not met, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
